identityDecision: Archived Foundation/Core/Master headers share moduleId roofing. These pair-scoped row IDs are review references only; preserve saved items and account progress through a separately qualified migration before runtime use.
sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say no, not yet and never, and ask for more or less
sourceFocusEnglish: no, nunca, nadie, nada, todavía no, más, menos, otro
sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell a crew member what is not ready yet, that nobody goes up without a harness, and ask for more material.
archivedFrenchFocusEnglish: Negation with ne...pas, ne...jamais, ne...personne, ne...rien, ne...plus and pas encore; non as a simple no; de after negation and quantities (pas d', plus de, moins de, un peu de); autre (another, other); encore (still, yet)

cards.reviewNote: The source unbound 'more' is broader than archived plus de, which means more of a quantity; choose contextual card and dictionary senses before scoring.
The source unbound 'less' is broader than archived moins de, which requires a following quantity; choose contextual card and dictionary senses.
Source 'another, other' is one card; archive groups un autre, une autre and d'autres. The current Spanish note also prohibits un otro. Resolve form/gender/number before a single scored face.
Source 'still, yet' needs context. Archived encore can mean still or again; yet in the negative phrase is pas encore. Decide isolated card sense and Reader linkage.
Source 'a little' is unbound; archived un peu de expects a following noun. The Reader has countable nails, where a few is quelques clous.
